data_description.use_sun_for_polling: When enabled, the integration checks Home Assistant's sun position (based on your home's location) and skips querying the inverter while the sun is below the threshold below, instead of retrying and logging warnings all night.
data_description.sun_elevation_threshold: Minimum sun elevation, in degrees above the horizon, required before polling resumes. Use a small negative value (e.g. -4) to allow for dawn/dusk twilight.
